label: Curved Welt 2.3 cm

profile.distinguishingDetail: The curved welt at 2.3 cm — known in Italian tailoring as the barchetta, or 'little boat' — describes a gentle upward arc across the chest that follows the natural curvature of the pectoral muscle. At the narrowest barchetta width, the curve is subtle and refined, adding a whisper of Italian character without overwhelming the jacket's overall silhouette. It is favoured on structured Neapolitan suits where the curve reads as a sophisticated counterpoint to the clean lapel line.
